Abstract.AbstractText: This study aimed to characterize multi-drug resistant P. mirabilis clones carrying a novel class 1 integron-borne blaIMP-1 In1359 was inserted into a large conjugative plasmid that also carried blaCTX-M-2 The production of carbapenemases in Enterobacteriaceae that are intrinsically resistant to polymyxins and tigecycline is very worrisome, representing a serious challenge to clinicians and infection control teams.
